items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: For example when I was doing a Tom Harrell record I had hired Charlie Haden for it.

ctx.x: Did you like to see the bass being recorded in a certain fashion? The acoustic bass?

Well yeah. Like you know several different things. One would be just stereo, a pair of mics. This is the way Manfred Eicher did everything with, you know everything in stereo. Two mics on each horn, two mics on the bass, and then more mics on the drums of course. And I had seen him do that in the studio. And let me see now. I like, you know I like the natural sound of the bass. Not all basses sound the same. Not all bass players hear their bass in the same way that I do either. For example when I was doing a Tom…
